EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST

CLINICAL HISTORY:
Pulmonary nodule follow-up.

COMPARISON:
None available.

FINDINGS:

LUNGS AND AIRWAYS:
There is a 5 mm solid pulmonary nodule in the posterior right lower lobe. Additional 4 mm solid pulmonary nodule in the left upper lobe. Mild dependent bibasilar atelectatic change. Central airways are patent.

PLEURA:
No pleural effusion or pneumothorax.

MEDIASTINUM AND HILA:
Right lower paratracheal lymph node measures 8 mm in short axis. No enlarged mediastinal or hilar lymph nodes.

HEART AND GREAT VESSELS:
Heart size is within normal limits. Mild coronary artery calcification.

UPPER ABDOMEN:
Partially visualized 1.5 cm left adrenal nodule, indeterminate.

BONES AND SOFT TISSUES:
No acute osseous abnormality.

IMPRESSION:

1. 5 mm solid posterior right lower lobe pulmonary nodule and 4 mm left upper lobe pulmonary nodule.
2. Mildly prominent 8 mm right lower paratracheal lymph node, nonspecific.
3. Partially visualized 1.5 cm left adrenal nodule. Consider comparison with prior abdominal imaging if available.

EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST

CLINICAL HISTORY:
Follow-up pulmonary nodules.

COMPARISON:
CT chest 02/10/2024.

FINDINGS:

LUNGS AND AIRWAYS:
Solid nodule at the posterior right lung base measures 6 mm, previously 5 mm. New 8 mm peripheral ground-glass opacity in the right upper lobe, favored infectious or inflammatory. No other new suspicious pulmonary nodule. Mild dependent bibasilar atelectatic change.

PLEURA:
No pleural effusion or pneumothorax.

MEDIASTINUM AND HILA:
No mediastinal or hilar lymphadenopathy.

HEART AND GREAT VESSELS:
Heart size is normal. Mild coronary artery calcification.

UPPER ABDOMEN:
Partially visualized left adrenal nodule measures 1.5 cm and is unchanged.

BONES AND SOFT TISSUES:
No acute osseous abnormality.

IMPRESSION:

1. Slight increase in size of the posterior right lung base nodule, now 6 mm.
2. New 8 mm peripheral right upper lobe ground-glass opacity, likely inflammatory. Recommend attention on follow-up.
3. Stable 1.5 cm left adrenal nodule.

UPPER ABDOMEN:
Upper abdominal evaluation is limited by the field of view.

IMPRESSION:

2. Resolution of the previously seen right upper lobe ground-glass opacity.
3. Mildly prominent 9 mm station 4R lymph node.

EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST

CLINICAL HISTORY:
Continued surveillance of pulmonary nodules.

COMPARISON:
CT chest 08/20/2025 and multiple prior examinations.

FINDINGS:

LUNGS AND AIRWAYS:
Subpleural solid nodule in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe measures 7 mm, unchanged. Small 4 mm left upper lobe pulmonary nodule is also unchanged from more remote examinations. No recurrent right upper lobe ground-glass opacity. No new suspicious pulmonary nodule.

PLEURA:
No pleural effusion or pneumothorax.

MEDIASTINUM AND HILA:
Right lower paratracheal lymph node measures 10 mm in short axis, similar to the prior examination. No other enlarged mediastinal or hilar lymph nodes.

HEART AND GREAT VESSELS:
Heart size is within normal limits. Mild coronary artery calcification.

UPPER ABDOMEN:
Stable nodular thickening of the left adrenal gland.

BONES AND SOFT TISSUES:
No acute osseous abnormality.

IMPRESSION:

1. Stable 7 mm subpleural right lower lobe pulmonary nodule and stable 4 mm left upper lobe pulmonary nodule.
2. No recurrence of the previously resolved right upper lobe ground-glass opacity.
3. Stable 10 mm right lower paratracheal lymph node.
4. Stable left adrenal nodular thickening.
